trailhead.name: Sirretta Trailhead (North Big Meadow), Kern Plateau

identifiedBy.fact: North Big Meadow trailhead at end of dirt road off 22S07; Cannell Trail then Sirretta Trail to the peak; 7 mi RT, 2200 ft gain, TH 7830 ft

notes: Carried from earlier pass; single non-land-manager placement, no USFS point. Chrome/Peakbagger unusable this pass, nothing new.

trailhead.name: Pacific Crest Trail at Canebrake Road (Chimney Creek Campground)

identifiedBy.fact: PCT crossing at Canebrake Rd; PCT south to saddle ~1/2 mi north of peak; north ridge class 3

placements.name: CANPCT Canebrake Rd at Pacific Crest Tr

notes: Carried from earlier pass. Possible alternate start at Rodecker Flat (east) not read.

identifiedBy.fact: Wikipedia lists Taboose Pass first among routes, easiest class 2; climber.org 2013/1838 climbed from Taboose Pass camp

notes: Moderate confidence: Wikipedia names Taboose Pass and West Ridge as routes without naming a trailhead; Sawmill Pass is a possible alternative.

trailhead.name: Road's End (Bubbs Creek Trail), Cedar Grove

identifiedBy.fact: Go up the Bubbs Creek and East Lake drainages past Lake Reflection to Thunder Col

placements.name: Bubbs Creek, Woods Creek, and Rae Lakes

notes: WEAK: rests on route text only; Onion Valley over Kearsarge Pass also reaches Bubbs Creek. No page about the route was readable (Wikipedia Thunder Mountain is a disambiguation page).
Wikipedia says approach is by PCT from Donner Pass or Palisades Tahoe, no trailhead named for the shorter way. Cold Stream TH (USFS 39.271123,-120.284665) remains an unconfirmed candidate.
Earlier Marvin Pass lead is a long approach report, ~25 km away, with a climber.org-only coordinate. No page found naming a standard-route start (Wikipedia page URL 404).
Two equal class 2 approaches (George Creek east side; Shepherd Pass NW face). Wikipedia names no trailhead. Stays stuck.
